title: The futur simple: je parlerai
summary: Say what will happen with the infinitive plus -ai, -as, -a, -ons, -ez, -ont. Learn a handful of irregular stems and the future after quand.
focus: Forming and using the futur simple
content:
## Building the futur simple

The **futur simple** says what will happen. Take the **infinitive** and add the endings **-ai, -as, -a, -ons, -ez, -ont** (they look like **avoir** in the present). Verbs in **-re** drop the final **-e** first: **prendre → je prendrai**.

| | parler | finir | vendre |
|---|---|---|---|
| je | parlerai | finirai | vendrai |
| tu | parleras | finiras | vendras |
| il / elle / on | parlera | finira | vendra |
| nous | parlerons | finirons | vendrons |
| vous | parlerez | finirez | vendrez |
| ils / elles | parleront | finiront | vendront |

Every form has an **r** just before the ending, so listen for it.

## Irregular stems

Some common verbs change the stem, but the endings never change.

| infinitive | stem | je … |
|---|---|---|
| être | ser- | je serai |
| avoir | aur- | j'aurai |
| aller | ir- | j'irai |
| faire | fer- | je ferai |
| venir | viendr- | je viendrai |
| pouvoir | pourr- | je pourrai |
| devoir | devr- | je devrai |
| savoir | saur- | je saurai |
| voir | verr- | je verrai |

Also **il pleuvra** (pleuvoir) and **il y aura** (il y a). Elision still applies: **j'aurai**, **j'irai**.

## Futur proche or futur simple?

You already know the **futur proche**: **aller + infinitive** (**je vais manger**). Both talk about the future.

- **Futur proche**: near, planned, everyday speech. *Je vais prendre le bus.* (I'm going to take the bus.)
- **Futur simple**: further away, or more definite. *Un jour, je parlerai couramment.* (One day I will speak fluently.)
- Predictions: *Demain, il fera beau.* (Tomorrow the weather will be nice.)
- Promises: *Je serai à l'heure, promis.* (I'll be on time, I promise.)

In conversation the two overlap a lot. The futur simple sounds a little more formal or certain.

## Quand + futur and time words

English says *when I **have** time*. French is logical. If the moment is still to come, the verb after **quand** is in the future too.

- **Quand j'aurai le temps, je lirai ce livre.** (When I have time, I'll read this book.)
- **Quand tu viendras, nous irons au marché.** (When you come, we'll go to the market.)

Time words that go with the future:

- **demain** (tomorrow), **après-demain** (the day after tomorrow)
- **la semaine prochaine**, **l'année prochaine** (next week, next year)
- **dans deux ans** (in two years' time)
- **bientôt** (soon), **un jour** (one day)

quiz.explanation: Aller has the irregular future stem ir-: nous irons.
hints: Aller does not keep its infinitive in the future.

quiz.prompt: Quand j'___ le temps, je lirai ce livre. (avoir)
quiz.explanation: Avoir has the stem aur-, and after quand the future is needed when the moment is still to come: quand j'aurai le temps.
hints: The stem of avoir in the future is aur-.
je takes -ai

quiz.explanation: Pouvoir has the irregular stem pourr- (two r's): tu pourras.
hints: The stem has a double r.

quiz.prompt: La semaine prochaine, ils ___ le projet. (finir)
quiz.explanation: This verb is regular. Take the infinitive finir and add -ont: ils finiront.
hints: Keep the whole infinitive.
ils takes -ont

quiz.prompt: True or false: French puts the future after quand when the moment is still to come, as in "Quand je serai grand, je serai pilote."
quiz.explanation: English says 'when I grow up' (present), but French uses the future after quand: quand je serai grand.
hints: Is 'growing up' still to come?

quiz.prompt: Which sentence is in the futur proche?
quiz.explanation: The futur proche is aller in the present plus an infinitive: je vais partir. Je partirai is the futur simple.
hints: Look for aller plus an infinitive.

quiz.explanation: Venir has the irregular stem viendr-: elle viendra.
hints: The stem is viendr-.
elle takes -a

quiz.prompt: True or false: "Je prendrerai le train" is correct French.
quiz.explanation: Verbs in -re drop the final -e before the ending: prendre becomes je prendrai.
hints: What happens to the -e of prendre?

quiz.explanation: Pleuvoir has the stem pleuvr-: il pleuvra.
hints: Like pouvoir, which becomes pourr-, the -oir disappears.

conversations.title: Summer plans
conversations.scenario: Camille and Hugo talk about what they will do this summer.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Qu'est-ce que tu feras cet été, Hugo ?
lines.meaning: What will you do this summer, Hugo?

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Je partirai en Bretagne avec ma sœur.
lines.meaning: I'll go to Brittany with my sister.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Super ! Vous prendrez le train ?
lines.meaning: Great! Will you take the train?

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Oui, et nous ferons du vélo là-bas.
lines.meaning: Yes, and we'll go cycling there.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Moi, je resterai à Lyon. Je travaillerai tout l'été.
lines.meaning: I'll stay in Lyon. I'll work all summer.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Tu viendras nous voir en août ?
lines.meaning: Will you come and see us in August?

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Quand j'aurai des vacances, je viendrai.
lines.meaning: When I have some holiday, I'll come.
lines.note: Quand takes the futur because the holiday is still to come.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Promis ? Il fera beau, tu verras.
lines.meaning: Promise? The weather will be nice, you'll see.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Promis. Je te téléphonerai la semaine prochaine.
lines.meaning: Promise. I'll phone you next week.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Parfait. On se verra bientôt !
lines.meaning: Perfect. We'll see each other soon!

listening.meaning: I'll be there tomorrow.

listening.text: Nous irons à la plage samedi.
listening.meaning: We'll go to the beach on Saturday.
listening.note: New word: la plage = the beach.

listening.text: Elle finira ses devoirs ce soir.
listening.meaning: She'll finish her homework this evening.
listening.note: Finir keeps its infinitive: elle finira.

listening.text: Il fera très chaud la semaine prochaine.
listening.meaning: It will be very hot next week.

listening.text: Quand vous arriverez, je vous montrerai la ville.
listening.meaning: When you arrive, I'll show you the town.

listening.text: Mes parents auront une nouvelle voiture l'année prochaine.
listening.meaning: My parents will have a new car next year.
listening.note: New word: la voiture = the car.

listening.text: Je te promets que je ne serai pas en retard.
listening.meaning: I promise you I won't be late.

listening.text: Dans deux ans, nous pourrons acheter une petite maison près de Lyon.
listening.meaning: In two years' time we'll be able to buy a little house near Lyon.

guide.tip: Hear an r just before -ai, -as, -a, -ons, -ez, -ont? It's the future.

concept.title: Si takes the present
concept.markdown: Careful: **si** (if) is not **quand**. After **si**, French uses the **present**, like English: **S'il fait beau, nous irons à la plage.** Only time words like **quand** take the future.

bites.title: Infinitive + -ai
bites.rule: The futur simple is the infinitive plus -ai, -as, -a, -ons, -ez, -ont. Verbs in -re drop the -e: prendre becomes je prendrai.
bites.example_meaning: I'll speak to the manager tomorrow.

bites.title: Irregular stems
bites.rule: The endings stay the same and the stem changes: ser- (être), aur- (avoir), ir- (aller), fer- (faire), viendr- (venir), pourr- (pouvoir), devr-, saur-, verr-.
bites.example: Nous serons à Paris et nous irons au Louvre.
bites.example_meaning: We'll be in Paris and we'll go to the Louvre.

bites.title: Proche or simple?
bites.rule: Use aller plus an infinitive for what is near and planned. Use the futur simple for predictions, promises and the further future.
bites.example: Je vais manger. Un jour, je voyagerai.
bites.example_meaning: I'm going to eat. One day I'll travel.

bites.title: Quand + futur
bites.rule: If the moment is still to come, the verb after quand is in the future too, unlike English.
bites.example: Quand j'aurai le temps, je t'écrirai.
bites.example_meaning: When I have time, I'll write to you.

sorts.title: Infinitive stem or irregular stem?
sorts.why: Regular verbs keep the infinitive (minus the -e of -re verbs). Être, aller, faire, venir and a few others have their own stem.

sorts.title: Futur proche or futur simple?
sorts.why: The futur proche is two words, aller plus an infinitive. The futur simple is one word with a future ending.

spots.why: Aller has the irregular stem ir-.

spots.sentence: Quand je suis grand, je serai médecin.
spots.why: After quand, a moment still to come takes the future.

spots.sentence: Ils prendreront le train de huit heures.
Tu fairas les courses ce soir ?

builds.meaning: We'll be in Paris next week.

builds.text: Quand tu viendras, nous mangerons ensemble.
builds.meaning: When you come, we'll eat together.
The weather will be nice tomorrow.

builds.text: Je te promets que je viendrai.

realm.content:
## Le futur à Eldmark

At the guild, every quest is a promise in the **futur simple**: demain, **nous irons** au donjon; Borin **sera** le guerrier; la mage Séla **fera** un sort. **Quand** takes the future too: **quand nous aurons le butin, nous rentrerons** à Highgate.

vocabulary.example: Demain, nous irons au donjon.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Tomorrow we'll go to the dungeon.

vocabulary.example: La guilde partira bientôt pour Frostmarch.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The guild will leave for Frostmarch soon.

vocabulary.example: Quand nous aurons le butin, nous rentrerons à Highgate.
vocabulary.example_meaning: When we have the loot, we'll go back to Highgate.

vocabulary.example: Nym promet qu'elle reviendra.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Nym promises she'll come back.

vocabulary.example: La prêtresse dit que l'avenir sera brillant.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The priestess says the future will be bright.

vocabulary.example: La semaine prochaine, Borin fera une quête à Deepanvil.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Next week Borin will do a quest in Deepanvil.

vocabulary.example: La quête sera longue.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The quest will be long.

vocabulary.example: Nous partagerons le butin.
vocabulary.example_meaning: We'll share the loot.

vocabulary.example: Le donjon sera sombre.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The dungeon will be dark.

bites.title: Les quêtes au futur
bites.rule: Quest plans use the infinitive plus -ai, -as, -a, -ons, -ez, -ont. The irregular stems stay irregular in Eldmark: ser-, aur-, ir-, fer-, viendr-.

sorts.title: Futur simple or futur proche in Eldmark?
sorts.why: One word with a future ending is the futur simple. Aller plus an infinitive is the futur proche.

hints: Quand takes the futur.
The stem of avoir is aur-.

meadowbrook.content:
## Le futur à Meadowbrook

A farm runs on plans. Au printemps, **je planterai** des fraises; en été, **elles pousseront**; à l'automne, **nous récolterons** les citrouilles pour la fête des récoltes. After **quand**, the future stays future: **quand il pleuvra, je n'arroserai pas**.

vocabulary.example: Demain, je planterai du maïs.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Tomorrow I'll plant corn.

vocabulary.example: L'année prochaine, nous aurons deux vaches.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Next year we'll have two cows.

vocabulary.example: Les fraises seront bientôt rouges.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The strawberries will soon be red.

vocabulary.example: Quand il fera beau, Léo ira pêcher.
vocabulary.example_meaning: When the weather is nice, Léo will go fishing.

vocabulary.example: Il pleuvra cette nuit sur la ferme.
vocabulary.example_meaning: It will rain on the farm tonight.

vocabulary.example: Quand j'aurai le temps, je cuisinerai une tarte.
vocabulary.example_meaning: When I have time, I'll bake a tart.

vocabulary.example: Nora plantera des fraises au printemps.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Nora will plant strawberries in spring.

vocabulary.example: Nous récolterons le maïs en septembre.
vocabulary.example_meaning: We'll harvest the corn in September.

vocabulary.example: La citrouille sera énorme.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The pumpkin will be huge.

vocabulary.example: Tout le village viendra à la fête des récoltes.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The whole village will come to the harvest festival.

bites.title: La ferme au futur
bites.rule: Farm plans use the futur simple: récolter becomes je récolterai, vendre becomes je vendrai, faire becomes il fera beau, and être becomes ce sera.

sorts.title: Which stem on the farm?
sorts.why: Récolter, planter and vendre (minus its -e) keep the infinitive. Être, faire and aller have their own stems.

hints: The stem of avoir is aur-.

hints: The stem of aller is ir-.

conversations.scenario: Nora, the new farmer, tells Rosa at the seed shop what she will grow this year.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Bonjour Rosa ! Je planterai des fraises ce printemps.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Bonne idée ! Elles seront belles en juin.
lines.meaning: Good idea! They'll be lovely in June.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Et à l'automne, je récolterai des citrouilles.
lines.meaning: And in autumn I'll harvest pumpkins.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Tu les vendras à la fête des récoltes ?
lines.meaning: Will you sell them at the harvest festival?

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Oui ! Et quand je serai riche, j'aurai une vache.
lines.meaning: Yes! And when I'm rich, I'll have a cow.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Alors je viendrai la voir !
lines.meaning: Then I'll come and see her!

rustwake.content:
## Le futur à Rustwake

Outside le Dôme, every day is a plan. Demain, **je chercherai** de l'eau filtrée; Marta **sera** au marché; **nous échangerons** des écrous. The radio-montre predicts the weather: **il y aura une tempête de cendres**. And **quand je reviendrai** au Dôme, **je réparerai** l'antenne.

vocabulary.example: Demain, je chercherai de l'eau filtrée.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Tomorrow I'll look for filtered water.

vocabulary.example: Le contremaître Ruiz ouvrira bientôt le Dôme.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Foreman Ruiz will open the Dome soon.

vocabulary.example: Quand je reviendrai au Dôme, je réparerai l'antenne.
vocabulary.example_meaning: When I come back to the Dome, I'll repair the antenna.

vocabulary.example: Marta promet qu'elle aura du soda Saphir.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Marta promises she'll have Saphir soda.

vocabulary.example: La semaine prochaine, nous explorerons le centre commercial en ruines.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Next week we'll explore the ruined shopping centre.

vocabulary.example: Dans deux ans, le village de ferraille sera une ville.
vocabulary.example_meaning: In two years' time the scrap village will be a town.

vocabulary.example: Tu paieras en écrous.
vocabulary.example_meaning: You'll pay in nuts.

vocabulary.example: Ma radio-montre sonnera à six heures.
vocabulary.example_meaning: My wrist radio will ring at six.

vocabulary.example: La tempête de cendres arrivera ce soir.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The ash storm will arrive this evening.

vocabulary.example: Léo réparera la radio.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Léo will repair the radio.

bites.title: Prévisions du désert
bites.rule: The radio-montre speaks in the futur simple: il y aura (avoir), il fera (faire), ce sera (être). Il y a becomes il y aura.
bites.example: Demain, il y aura de la poussière.

listening.meaning: We'll trade nuts for water.

sorts.why: The future has an r-stem and a future ending: aur-a, ser-ai, fer-ons.

quiz.prompt: Demain, il y ___ une tempête de cendres.
quiz.explanation: Il y a becomes il y aura in the future, because avoir has the stem aur-.
hints: Il y a uses avoir.

conversations.title: Before the storm
